Site information

Before you browse.

Curious readers, students, and self-learners who want to read about business decisions, international markets, negotiation, AI-assisted research, and philosophy, including how early-stage work develops.

There is no fixed publishing schedule. New posts appear irregularly when Houcine has a piece of writing or a project result worth documenting. The site does not promise weekly or monthly updates.

All currently published writing and project pages are free to read. There are no paid tiers, memberships, paywalls, or paid downloads. There is no email newsletter or mailing list. Readers can follow new writing with the RSS feed at /feed.xml.

There is no guest-author program or formal pitch/submission process, and guest posts are not currently being solicited. Technical feedback about the Ultimate Reality Researcher project can be directed to its public GitHub repository.

Read the full FAQ, browse topics, or subscribe to the RSS feed.

For now

I update this site when I have something worth recording. Some entries are more developed than others, and the page should make that clear.
